cohort: Same fixed 151 PAs/563 eligible July 2025 DEV pitches, all six games; no new row selection
training: No refit, frozen checkpoint Q arrays and April TRAIN repertoire only; no CV

candidates.hypothesis: Small Q gaps and pitcher-specific concentration make a fixed near-value repertoire rule worth screening
candidates.rule: Among supported actions with 100*(max ensemble Q - action Q)<=epsilon_pp, choose largest April repertoire count of its pitch type, then larger ensemble Q, then original action index
candidates.axis: Current action selection only; Q and future continuation unchanged

candidates.hypothesis: Low five-member top-action unanimity motivates reducing worst member's within-state action regret
candidates.rule: For each action compute max_m(100*(max_a Q_m(a)-Q_m(action))) across seeds42-46; minimize it, ties by higher ensemble Q then original action index
candidates.axis: Current action selection only; frozen member Q and future continuation unchanged

support_rule: Require identical action identities/order across ensemble and five members for every PA, otherwise fail the comparison rather than intersect/reselect silently
evaluation: One observed pre-pitch action contrast only, each frozen judge retains its own optimized PA continuation. Not the value of rolling out the candidate at every future pitch or an inning policy
sensitivity: For five leave-one-member-out folds, reference=max arithmetic mean Q of remaining four members; near-value rule uses that same mean Q; minimax uses remaining four regrets and that mean Q for ties. Evaluate each on held-out member's Q; report held-out candidate-minus-reference differences and five-fold action/type unanimity. Arithmetic mean Q control is not a reconstructed ensemble and is not a third improvement candidate
bootstrap_cluster: game_pk, paired contrasts, all six fixed games; exploratory 95 percent percentile CI
selection_rule: No hyperparameter selection or second DEV pass with changed thresholds. Report all outcomes. Negative mean full-ensemble current-action contrast is model-internal worsening, even if concentration or stability improves. Such candidates are rejected for service adoption. Any remaining candidate still requires identified policy evaluation; absent OPE means defer, never adopt
